name: Hotel Sattlerwirt
beschreibung: Hotel Sattlerwirt is situated in Ebbs near Kufstein, nestled at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser mountains. The family-run hotel's peaceful rural atmosphere guarantees a rejuvenating stay. The on-site wellness area features an indoor pool, diverse saunas, and serene relaxation rooms. Half-board dining showcases multi-course menus featuring seasonal Tyrolean produce. The location is ideal for hiking and cycling in the Kaisergebirge, with quick winter access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Sattlerwirt in Ebbs near Kufstein provides a peaceful countryside setting, an indoor pool, a sauna wellness world, fine Tyrolean dining, and easy access to the Wilder Kaiser.
